description: This file sets up authentication-related API endpoints using FastAPI for a sports live stream platform backend. It includes login, current user retrieval, profile updates, and token refresh functionalities, utilizing user models, database repositories, and utility functions.

methods.name: login_user( login_data: UserLogin = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles user login by verifying credentials and returning a JWT token and user info.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's profile based on trusted user identification.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_update: UserUpdate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates the current user's profile with provided data.

methods.name: refresh_access_token( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Refreshes the user's access token (mock implementation).
